Speedy Croissant Women/NB Ride

Cambridge, MA · Alewife · Road

Speedy Croissant Women/NB Ride is a road group ride in Cambridge, MA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 am from Minuteman Bikeway trailhead, Alewife.

For visitors

For women, women-identifying and nonbinary riders. Register on the event page. Guests may do two CRW rides a year before joining. Paceline experience required; helmets required.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 16+ mph show-and-go; optional paceline. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Speedy Croissant Women/NB Ride group ride

A spirited early-morning ride from the Alewife end of the Minuteman Bikeway for women, women-identifying and nonbinary riders, part of the club's Women's/Nonbinary Program. It holds 16+ mph and does not regroup, so riders need paceline experience. The slower Praline Croissant ride runs on Fridays.
